upstream.notes: Random class diagrams from a seeded generator, captured like class-geometry.json (real mermaid 11.16.0, headless Chrome, the bundled Noto fonts): every class, note, relationship path, label, cardinality, namespace and the canvas. The cases the generator offers that mermaid refuses are left out (`refused`).
